title: Practice: The -ся passive and present passive participles: читается, издаваемый

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: This house has a heated swimming pool.
exercises.why: Sometimes the actor is not mentioned. Such constructions can often be expressed by impersonal active constructions with the verb in the 3rd person plural: *Рыба подаётся здесь редко. — Рыбу подают здесь редко. Этот вопрос обсуждался вчера. — Этот вопрос обсуждали вчера. The Russian imperfective passive constructions convey the idea of generalization, continuation, repetition or incomplete action. The present passive participle may be encountered quite often in written language, particularly in newspapers. In spoken language, with the exception of a limited number of verbs, it is rarely used. It doesn't have a short form and can only be used as a modifier: *Опыты, производимые нашей… — DLI, Lessons 96 and 97.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Sometimes the actor is not mentioned. (DLI, Lessons 96 and 97)
